## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

```
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors

│   └── 📂 text_encoders/

```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

Cinematic anime fantasy character trailer, elegant winter night, blue-white magical color palette, crystalline flower, drifting snow, strong foreground and background parallax, dramatic shot changes, professional anime opening cinematography.

Use the original image as the strict character and costume reference. Preserve exactly the same purple-haired woman, violet-red eyes, white top hat, blue flower and feather decorations, white military-style coat, blue gloves, jewelry, facial features and body proportions.

IMPORTANT: This must be a six-shot edited sequence with clearly visible camera movement and hard cuts. Do not render it as one continuous static portrait. Every shot must use a different framing or camera angle.

[0s-1.3s — SHOT 1: MACRO OPENING]
Extreme macro close-up of the glowing blue flower hovering above her gloved palm.

The camera rapidly dollies backward from the center of the flower while making a small clockwise rotation, gradually revealing her blue glove and part of her white coat. The flower petals unfold one by one. Blue magical particles fly past the lens, creating strong foreground parallax.

End the shot when one luminous petal moves directly across the camera.

[1.3s-3s — SHOT 2: HARD CUT TO MOVING MEDIUM SHOT]
Hard cut as the petal fills the screen.

Reveal the woman in a low-angle medium portrait. The camera tracks quickly from left to right while simultaneously orbiting approximately 20 degrees around her, creating obvious parallax between her face, raised hand, falling snow, distant trees and warm city lights.

Her purple hair, hat ribbons and coat edges move in the winter wind. She looks at the flower while a small cloud of white breath leaves her lips. The floating flower follows her hand naturally.

[3s-4.4s — SHOT 3: EYE CLOSE-UP]
A large foreground snowflake crosses the lens and creates a sharp cut to an extreme close-up of her violet-red eyes.

The camera performs a fast, controlled push-in toward her eyes, then suddenly stops. Blue light from the flower travels across her eyelashes and reflects inside her pupils. She blinks once, then shifts her gaze from the flower toward the viewer.

The brim of her hat creates a cinematic shadow across the upper part of her face.

[4.4s-6.1s — SHOT 4: ORBITING PROFILE]
Match cut using the blue reflection in her eye.

Cut to a three-quarter side profile. The camera performs a clearly visible clockwise orbit from her side toward the front of her face, moving around her by approximately 35 degrees.

As the camera moves, the magical flower rises from her palm and floats beside her cheek. A circular ribbon of frost spirals around the flower and her wrist. Her curled purple hair passes through the foreground, creating layered depth and natural motion.

[6.1s-7.6s — SHOT 5: FLOWER POV AND RACK FOCUS]
A glowing blue petal sweeps across the screen, creating a fast foreground-wipe transition.

Cut to a close shot from behind the floating flower, looking toward the woman. The flower is initially sharp while her face is blurred. Perform a dramatic rack focus: the flower becomes blurred and her eyes become perfectly sharp.

At the same time, the camera slides diagonally upward and to the left. She slowly raises her chin, looks directly through the flower toward the camera, and forms a restrained, confident smile.

[7.6s-10s — SHOT 6: FINAL HERO SHOT]
The flower releases a brief blue flash, creating a hard cut to the final hero shot.

Start with the camera slightly above and to the right of the woman. Perform a descending crane movement combined with a smooth counterclockwise arc and a gradual dolly backward, revealing more of her white coat, raised hand and snowy surroundings.

Several glowing blue petals orbit around her at different distances from the camera. Foreground petals move rapidly while distant particles move slowly, producing strong cinematic parallax.

During the final second, the camera movement slows down. The flower returns gently to the space above her palm. She faces the viewer with an elegant, mysterious smile. A vertical blue beam brightens behind her and outlines the brim of her white hat, hair and shoulders.

Hold the final composition completely stable for the last 0.4 seconds.

Editing style: six clearly separated shots, hard cuts, match cuts, foreground petal wipes and snowflake wipes. No cross dissolves, no title cards, no text.

Camera language: macro dolly-out, lateral tracking shot, rapid eye push-in, 35-degree character orbit, rack focus, diagonal camera slide, descending crane shot, counterclockwise final arc, strong foreground parallax.

Character motion: natural blinking, subtle breathing, slight gaze changes, small chin movement and restrained smile. Her body and raised hand remain mostly stable.

Lighting: cold blue moonlight, warm distant bokeh, blue magical light from the flower, moving reflections across her eyes and white coat.

Audio description: cold winter wind, soft crystalline chimes, magical energy rising at 4.4 seconds, a sharp glass-like sound during each cut, orchestral swell from 7.6 seconds, final bell chime at 9.6 seconds.

Cinematic anime fantasy sequence, elegant snowy night, romantic red-and-blue color palette, luminous snowfall, soft volumetric lighting, delicate facial animation, flowing hair and fabric, subtle magical atmosphere.

Use the original image as the strict visual reference. Keep exactly the same female character, facial features, pink hair, violet eyes, red-and-white Chinese-style outfit, jewelry, body proportions, snowy forest background, and over-the-shoulder portrait composition. Preserve her identity and costume details throughout the entire video.

The character must remain the central subject in every shot. Do not replace her with unrelated objects or environments.

[0s-1s]
Begin with the original composition. The woman stands quietly with her back partially turned toward the camera. Snowflakes drift slowly through the foreground and background. A gentle winter breeze moves the ends of her long pink hair, red veil, earrings, sleeve fabric, and hanging tassels. She blinks naturally once. The camera performs an extremely slow cinematic push-in.

[1s-2.2s]
She slowly turns her head a few degrees toward the viewer and looks directly into the camera with a calm, confident expression. A soft cloud of white breath leaves her lips and dissolves into the cold air. Warm golden light from the right side travels gently across her cheek, eyes, hair, and shoulder embroidery. Her face and identity remain stable and highly detailed.

[2.2s-3.4s]
Cut to a close-up of her violet eyes and upper face. A bright snowflake passes close to the lens, creating a brief natural light flare. Her eyelashes move subtly as she narrows her eyes into a faint, elegant smile. Reflections of blue snow light and warm lantern bokeh shimmer inside her eyes.

[3.4s-4.3s]
Cut back to a medium portrait. Several red camellia petals rise from the snow and spiral gently around her, echoing the red floral ornaments in her hair and clothing. She raises one hand slightly toward a drifting petal. Her sleeve and jewelry respond naturally to the movement. The camera makes a small clockwise arc around her, creating subtle parallax between the character, snowy trees, and distant lights.

[4.3s-5s]
One red petal passes very close to the camera and briefly fills the frame. As it clears, reveal the character facing the viewer in a graceful final pose. She gives a restrained, mysterious smile while her hair and veil settle slowly. A star-shaped light behind her shoulder flashes once, then the frame becomes calm and stable for the ending.

Editing style: elegant cinematic cuts motivated by snowflakes and flower petals, no unrelated title cards, no scene replacement, no aggressive transitions, no sudden flashes.

Camera motion: slow push-in, one close-up cut, subtle clockwise camera arc, shallow depth of field, gentle foreground parallax. No rapid camera movement, no full-body rotation.

Character motion: natural blinking, slight head turn, subtle breathing, restrained smile, small hand movement. No exaggerated body movement.

Audio description: quiet winter wind, delicate Chinese bells, soft cinematic strings, faint footsteps in snow, a subtle crystalline chime during the final star-shaped light flare.
